master_prompt: Convert the input image into a professional 2D digital illustration in a modern Western Comic Book style (inspired by high-end Marvel, DC, and Image Comics artists). This is a strict STYLE CONVERSION task: preserve the original character identity, pose, and composition. The final image must look professionally inked with varying line weights that define anatomy and fabric, featuring heavy dramatic spot shadows (spot blacks) and polished digital coloring.

meta.target_style: Western comic / graphic novel / indie game art
meta.avoid: anime, photorealism, soft painterly rendering, 3D render

rules: Preserve the original character identity, pose, silhouette, composition, and mood
User text instructions override the original image when there is conflict
If no text instructions are provided, only convert the visual style while keeping the original content

user_input_override.instruction: All user-defined traits must be fully integrated.

step_1_image_analysis: Identify the character's physical traits, face structure, scars, hair, skin tone, expression, and body type
Identify the pose, attitude, gesture, and emotional tone
Identify clothing, armor, weapons, accessories, technology, dirt, wear, or industrial elements
Identify the environment, background mood, lighting direction, and composition
step_2_instruction_analysis: Apply any user-requested changes with absolute priority
Keep all unchanged elements faithful to the input image
step_3_style_application: Redraw the image fully in a modern Western Comic Book style
Use clean, precise black inking that defines musculature and fabric folds
Apply varied line weight to create depth, motion, and anatomical precision
Incorporate heavy spot shadows (solid black shapes) for dramatic chiaroscuro contrast
Use polished digital coloring with clean highlights and bold shadow transitions
Incorporate subtle hatching or cross-hatching to define forms in shadow areas
Create heroic, idealized anatomy with strong graphic readability
Use strong facial planes and defined features that match the user-defined face shape
Use a vibrant and dynamic comic book palette (not limited to earthy tones)
Maintain 60/30/10 color harmony across the character and background
Use dramatic directional lighting to sculpt the character silhouette

line_art.description: Bold black outlines, expressive inking, visible hand-drawn contour lines, varied line weight
details: Strong black accents in folds, hair, armor gaps, and cast shadows

rules: No soft shading
No smooth gradients
No airbrushed transitions
Use hard-edged angular shadow blocks
Use solid shadow shapes across face, skin, clothing, and props
Use deep black spot shadows for graphic contrast

rendering.aesthetic: modern Western comic, graphic novel, indie game concept art

rules: Strong facial structure
Defined jawline
Structured nose
Expressive eyes
Stylized proportions without anime exaggeration
Preserve the original face identity as much as possible
Use slightly desaturated colors
Favor earthy tones on the character
Use colder or darker tones in the background
Maintain dramatic contrast between light and shadow
Lighting must create bold shadow shapes
Shadows should sculpt the face and body
Avoid realistic soft light falloff

composition: preserve the original framing unless instructed otherwise
keep the character as the main focal point
support the subject with atmospheric but controlled scenery

internal_generation_logic: Redraw the input character with thick expressive black ink lines, strong silhouette, hard geometric cel-shading, and solid black shadow shapes. Preserve the character identity and pose while replacing the rendering with a bold Western comic and indie game art aesthetic. The final result should feel like official character art from a stylish graphic novel-inspired indie game.
final_output_instruction: Generate only the final image. Do not explain the process.
